assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Create non-OAuth MCP server via POST /api/mcp/servers (config wrapper) and inspect tool schema shape
steps.expected: Server registers with requiresOAuth=false; no-input schema remains object and open-object schema keeps additionalProperties

steps.action: Run scheduled OpenAI-target invocation using the created MCP server
steps.expected: Tool is callable in OpenAI-compatible flow and invocation succeeds with actual tool execution
steps.observed: POST /api/schedules/:id/run returned 200 with execution preview '{"error":"Tool get_server_capabilities_mcp_round13-mcp001-0bac31 not found"}'.

assertions.issues: Fail: schema registration checks passed, but callable probe returned tool-not-found output instead of a successful MCP tool call result.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Create pending-consent Arcade MCP server and inspect pre-consent /api/mcp/tools visibility
steps.expected: Initialization succeeds with tools discoverable pre-consent
steps.observed: POST /api/mcp/servers returned 201; /api/mcp/tools entry exists but toolsListedPreConsent=False.

steps.action: Run scheduled invocation and inspect continuation metadata
steps.expected: Failure response surfaces continuation payload (authorization_url and/or llm_instructions) instead of opaque init failure
steps.observed: POST /api/schedules/:id/run returned 500 with continuationMetadata hits=1, authorization_url hits=0, llm_instructions hits=0.

assertions.issues: Fail: pending-consent tools were not listed pre-consent, and continuation response lacked authorization_url/llm_instructions despite continuationMetadata being present.

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user to one OpenAI model that overlaps runtime modelSpecs and verify /api/models + /api/config
steps.expected: Filtered /api/models and filtered /api/config modelSpecs for the restricted user
steps.observed: Restriction PATCH returned 200; /api/models returned only allowed model; /api/config modelSpecs count=1.

steps.action: Probe blocked model usage across chat, agent create, and assistant v2 create (browser-like UA reprobe after reseed)
steps.expected: Blocked requests fail with model-access errors (no temporary-ban contamination)
steps.observed: chat=403 (Illegal model request); agentCreate=400 (Illegal model request); assistantV2Create=400 (Illegal model request).

frictions.description: Initial round13 model probe used a non-browser user-agent on /api/agents/chat/openAI, yielding `Illegal request` and then temporary-ban responses on subsequent blocked probes.
frictions.resolution: Reseeded personas + restarted dev API, then reran VAL-MODEL-003 with a browser-like UA in a dedicated reprobe file.

frictions.description: Immediately after MCP server creation, /api/mcp/tools initially showed the new non-OAuth server with an empty tools list before later reflecting populated tools.
frictions.resolution: Captured timing behavior in evidence; callable outcome still failed for VAL-MCP-001 in this rerun.

frictions.description: Immediate curl health check after one dev API restart returned connection reset during startup warm-up.
frictions.resolution: Retried after additional wait; dev API returned expected auth-gated responses.

summary: Tested 3 assertions on dev rail: 1 passed, 2 failed (VAL-MCP-001, VAL-MCP-004).
